title.quote: CAMMARL : Conformal Action Modeling in Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: This is the title printed at the start of the paper.
title.value: CAMMARL : Conformal Action Modeling in Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning

extractions.description: Empirical multi-agent reinforcement-learning paper introducing CAMMARL, which trains actor-critic agents together with a conformal action-prediction model and compares it with several agent-modeling baselines across four named multi-agent environments.

type.quote: Through several experiments in two fully cooperative multi-agent tasks, we show that CAMMARL elevates the capabilities of an autonomous agent in MARL
type.justification: The paper proposes a method and evaluates it through computational experiments.

name.quote: we propose a novel multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithm CAMMARL
name.justification: The principal claimed contribution is an algorithm for MARL.

name.quote: our proposal of predicting conformal sets of actions of the other agents in the environment (with high probability) is novel
name.justification: The work contributes a conformal-prediction approach for predicting other agents' actions.

name.quote: an essential skill for an agent to have is the ability to reason about other agents in the environment. There has been considerable research addressing this problem of agent or opponent modeling
name.justification: The paper directly advances agent modeling by learning confidence sets for other agents' actions.

name.quote: Developing systems of autonomous agents capable of effective multi-agent interactions can be very useful in modern cooperative artificial intelligence (AI).
name.justification: The proposed method addresses cooperative interaction among autonomous agents.

name.quote: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) has certainly shown its advantages
name.justification: MBRL is discussed as related context, while CAMMARL is not presented as an environment world-model method.

name.quote: Research in the field of IRL also relates to our work
name.justification: Inverse reinforcement learning is discussed only as related work.
